title: Grieg - Peer Gynt Suite No. 1, Op. 46 - IV. In the Hall of the Mountain King
performer: Czech National Symphony Orchestra, as the Musopen Symphony Orchestra (Musopen Kickstarter project, 2012)
format: Ogg Vorbis, 48 kHz, stereo, about 128 kbps
license: Public domain: commissioned by Musopen and released to the public domain (PD-author). Unlike the Orpheus recording, this is a modern studio recording, not an LP transfer.
notes: Complete piece, with the full accelerando.

excerpt.notes: The whole piece: the steady accelerando and crescendo is the point of this song, so nothing is skipped.
